description.value:
You launch a warbling bolt of energy at a creature within range. Make a ranged tech attack; on a hit, the target takes 2d8 plus 1d6 damage. Pick one of the two d8s rolled; the number showing sets the damage type according to the table below.

  • 1 - Acid
  • 2 - Cold
  • 3 - Fire
  • 4 - Energy
  • 5 - Ion
  • 6 - Lightning
  • 7 - Poison
  • 8 - Sonic

If both d8s show the same number, the bolt arcs onward to a different creature of your choice within 30 feet of the original target; make a fresh attack and damage roll against the new target, which can trigger the bolt to leap again. No creature can be struck more than once by a single casting.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, each target takes an extra 1d6 damage of the rolled type for each slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
